description: This file contains utility functions for managing and checking usage quotas such as storage, predictions, and user/flow limits within a subscription-based system. It includes functions to get current usage, check limits, and update usage cache, with specific handling for monthly prediction limits.

methods.name: getCurrentUsage
methods.description: Retrieves current storage and predictions usage for an organization, along with their limits, based on cache data and quotas.

methods.name: checkUsageLimit
methods.description: Checks if the current usage exceeds the quota limits for flows or users and throws an error if limits are exceeded.

methods.name: updatePredictionsUsage
methods.description: Increments the predictions usage count in cache, setting a TTL aligned with the monthly cycle.

methods.name: checkPredictions
methods.description: Verifies if the predictions usage has exceeded the quota limit and throws an error if so.

methods.name: updateStorageUsage
methods.description: Updates the total storage usage in cache for an organization.

methods.name: checkStorage
methods.description: Checks if the storage usage exceeds the storage limit and throws an error if so.
